crossRefs.note: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
For there will arise false christs, and false prophets, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead…
“Behold, I have told you beforehand.
Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.
But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before…
But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.
He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is…
looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up…
I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.
Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?
I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.
that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse…
holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ, that I didn’t run in vain nor…
Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.
But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings;
Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.
Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the…
He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice…
Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.
and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

translations.web: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
translations.bsb: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.
translations.kjv: Look to yourselves, that ➔ we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
translations.asv: Look to yourselves, that ye lose not the things which we have wrought, but that ye receive a full reward.
